source_title: Semi Conductor Laboratory (SCL) Recruitment 2026: Notification Out For Technical/Administrative Posts, Check Eligibility - Jagran Josh
source_excerpt:
SCL Recruitment 2026: The recruitment drive aims to fill 83 vacancies including Technical Assistant, Technician 'B', Administrative Officer, Accounts Officer, Junior Personal Assistant and others. Check eligibility, application process and others.
Semi Conductor Laboratory (SCL) Recruitment 2026: The Semi-Conductor Laboratory (SCL), an Autonomous Body under the Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India has released detailed notification for the recruitment of various Technical and Administrative posts in the Employment News (24-30) October 2026.
Semi Conductor Laboratory (SCL) is currently accepting applications for 83 various posts including Technical Assistant, Technician 'B', Administrative Officer, Accounts Officer, Junior Personal Assistant and others.
The detailed advertisement regarding the various Technical and Administrative posts is available on the official website www.scl.gov.in/career.html. The notification pdf will provide you all the crucial details including eligibility, selection process, age limit, and others. You can download the pdf directly through the link given below-
Interested and eligible candidates can apply online for these posts from November 01, 2026. The last date to apply online is November 30, 2026. Check the table below for all the crucial dates related to recruitment drive-
A total of 83 multiple posts in Administrative and Technical wings are to be filled through the recruitment drive including Technical Assistant, Technician 'B', Administrative Officer, Accounts Officer, Junior Personal Assistant and others. Check the details of the posts given below-
Candidates can apply online for these posts through the link for on-line Application Form available on SCL web-site-www.scl.gov.in/career.html.
As per the application process, upon the registration and successful submission of application, applicants will be provided with an on-line Registration Number through SMS/e-mail. on registered Mobile number/registered e-mail.
Upload the valid photos, signatures, and certificates to the link.
Submit the requisite fee as a part of the application process to the concerned link.
Candidates are required to possess a valid e-mail ID to apply for these posts.
A Registered and valid Mobile number of the applicant will have to be given in the application compulsorily.
